column1: Supplementary Table 4. Summary of physiological, settlement, and photosynthetic performance metrics comparing High-Fluorescent (HF) and Non-Fluorescent (NF) Stylophora pistillata planulae across multiple experimental treatments and environmental stress conditions (Ambient, 27°C, 32°C, pH 7.8, pH 7.6, 50m light level, and Dark). The table includes mean values for each morphotype, sample sizes (nHF and nNF), p-values, statistical significance levels, and statistical tests used (Mann-Whitney U or Welch's t-test).
